keynoteProfiles.name: Dr. Fernando Martirena
keynoteProfiles.role: Director, CIDEM · Head of LC3 Technical Resource Centre Latin America
keynoteProfiles.affiliation: Universidad Central “Marta Abreu” de Las Villas, Cuba
keynoteProfiles.bio: Fernando Martirena directs the Centre for Research and Development of Structures and Materials (CIDEM) at Universidad Central “Marta Abreu” de Las Villas in Cuba. A co-developer of Limestone Calcined Clay Cement (LC3), he works on sustainable construction materials, pozzolans and the practical use of low-carbon materials, including applications in social housing.
keynoteProfiles.attendeeValue: His expertise offers a practical perspective on taking low-carbon cement from research into production and construction, helping researchers and engineers connect material innovation with real applications.

keynoteProfiles.name: Dr. Sofía Sánchez Berriel
keynoteProfiles.affiliation: Universidad Central “Marta Abreu” de Las Villas, Cuba
keynoteProfiles.bio: Sofía Sánchez Berriel is an economist at Universidad Central “Marta Abreu” de Las Villas in Cuba and a member of the LC3 research community. Her work examines the economic and environmental performance of cement and concrete, with a focus on low-carbon cement. Her research includes life cycle assessment and eco-efficiency studies that compare LC3 with conventional cement in the Cuban context.
keynoteProfiles.attendeeValue: Her expertise helps delegates assess both the environmental benefits and economic case for low-carbon cement, supporting more informed decisions about materials, investment and sustainable construction.
